command: async (page) => { const identities=await page.locator("[data-pid]").evaluateAll(es=>es.filter(e=>["Ghost","Nightsurge"].includes(e.textContent.trim())).map(e=>({id:e.dataset.pid,name:e.textContent.trim()}))); const ids=[...new Set(identities.map(x=>x.id))]; const endpoints=["/api/state",...ids.map(id=>"/api/players/"+id+"/profile")]; const results=[]; for(const endpoint of endpoints){const r=await page.request.get(new URL(endpoint,page.url()).href);results.push({endpoint,status:r.status(),body:await r.text()});} return {identities,results,wire:globalThis.mentorWire||[]}; }
